label: GURPS High-Tech
notes: GCA cites this book as HT120, the plain prefix, and no record also cites a Basic Set page, so overlap.txt is empty. PDF page = book page + 1. The data file (Eric B. Smith, October 2023, marked incomplete) holds the gun perks and techniques of the appendix, armour and weapons only: no general gear, accessories, explosives, mines, melee weapons, covert-ops or medical gear, drugs or vehicles, which are captured from the PDF (#347) or kept by hand (#346). Its [MODIFIERS] are equipment options, weapon quality and ammunition, every one a calculated field or a load rather than a modifier item (#357, #364, #374), so none is written. Fragmentation before the damage type, follow-up and linked modes shared by sibling modes, rate-of-fire marks and placeholder modes parse since sargas79/GWorldVTT#591, and a missile's minimum range since #592 (gworld 1.35.0); the dry runs against the pinned 1.25.0 and against GWorldVTT main are in TRIAGE.md. Four shields and three split-DR armours the parser rejects are kept by hand (#346). Folded-stock and bipod pairs stay modes until #372 decides on states. See TRIAGE.md.
